title: exudyn/misc/symbolicUserItems.py: user items with the interfaces of the built-in items
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.55: a collection of user items with symbolic user functions whose creation has the same interface as the built-in items of itemInterface (a user rigid body as ObjectRigidBody, parameters the user item lacks refused or ignored with a note), so that the same systems are built with the same calls: at least mass point 3D, rigid body 3D, revolute, prismatic, spherical and distance joint, spring-damper, torsional spring-damper, sphere-sphere contact; first the list of what a good representation of multibody systems needs. Before the symbolic system model goes deeper.
releaseNotes: exudyn.symbolics.userItems.UserItemCreator creates user items with the Create functions of mbs and their arguments: ground, mass point, rigid body, spring-damper, Cartesian, torsional and rigid-body spring-damper, sphere-sphere contact, revolute, prismatic and spherical joint, distance and coordinate constraint, force and torque; the same script builds the system of built-in or of user items, which are recorded per kind and checked against the built-in items by the examples of the Create functions.
